description: Test drive system for previewing configured Clawdbot before deployment

concept.purpose: Allow business owners to 'test drive' their configured bot personality and capabilities before they have access to the actual deployment
concept.analogy: Like sitting in a configured car at the dealership, or seeing a tailored suit on a mannequin with your measurements
value: Creates emotional connection with the product
Differentiates from competitors who just deploy blindly

live_preview.name: Live Preview Chat
live_preview.description: Interactive chat window that simulates how the configured bot will respond
features: Real-time responses based on personality config
Uses actual AI with configured persona
Shows how greetings, clarifications, apologies will sound
Limited to preview scenarios (not full deployment)
live_preview.implementation: Lightweight API endpoint that wraps Claude/OpenAI with system prompt generated from personality config

scenario_playback.name: Scenario Playback
scenario_playback.description: Pre-recorded conversation scripts showing the bot in common situations

scenarios.name: First Customer Contact
scenarios.description: New customer reaches out for the first time

scenarios.name: Handling Frustration
scenarios.description: Customer is upset about an issue

turns.message: This is ridiculous! I've been waiting for days!
I need to speak with a manager

comparison_view.name: Side-by-Side Comparison
comparison_view.description: Show how the same scenario plays out with different personality settings
comparison_view.use_case: Help business owner decide between personality options

example.left_response: I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me look into this matter and provide you with a resolution.
example.right_response: Oh no, I'm so sorry you're dealing with this! That sounds really frustrating. Let me help make this right for you.

voice_samples.name: Voice Sample Gallery
voice_samples.description: Quick samples showing bot voice in different situations

preview_report.name: Configuration Summary Report
preview_report.description: PDF/printable summary of the configured bot for stakeholder review
preview_report.use_case: Share with stakeholders for approval before deployment

a_b_testing.name: A/B Personality Testing
a_b_testing.description: Create multiple personality variants and compare them
workflow: Run same test scenarios on both

personas.name: Happy Returning Customer
personas.description: Previous customer with a simple question

personas.name: Frustrated & Urgent
personas.description: Customer with a problem who is upset

personas.name: Just Browsing
personas.description: Not ready to buy, just looking

run_simulation.watch_conversation: See how your bot handles this customer type
run_simulation.identify_issues: Spot where personality config might need adjustment

feedback_collection.name: Test Drive Feedback
feedback_collection.description: Collect business owner's impressions during test drive

prompts.question: Did this greeting sound right for your brand?
On a scale of 1-10, how well does this match your vision?

preview_api.description: Lightweight endpoint for test drive conversations
preview_api.approach: Generate system prompt from personality config, use Claude API with strict limits

offline_mode.description: Generate all preview content at config time
offline_mode.approach: Pre-generate responses for all scenarios, store in config
offline_mode.benefit: No API calls needed during actual test drive

hybrid.description: Pre-generate common scenarios, allow limited live chat
hybrid.approach: Best of both worlds - fast playback plus interactive exploration
